sections.title: Viewer Commands
sections.description: Available to everyone in itsVDB's Twitch chat.

commands.description: Open this complete Kiwi Birb command guide.
Transfer some of your Shinies to another viewer.
Show the five viewers with the largest Shinies balances.
Play Kiwi Birb's slot machine while Gamba is open.
Choose an answer in the active prediction. Picks do not cost Shinies.
Show featured items and open The Nest Shop.
Buy an available shop item using its item ID or name.
List the chat text effects you own and show the one currently equipped.
Equip one of your unlocked chat text effects.
Remove your currently equipped chat text effect.

sections.title: Moderator Commands
sections.description: Restricted to itsVDB and Twitch moderators.

commands.description: Add Shinies to a viewer's balance.
Remove Shinies from a viewer's balance.
Set a viewer's Shinies balance to an exact amount.
Open a fixed-reward prediction with a question, answer options, and prize.
Close the active prediction so no more viewers can pick.
Choose the winning option and award the configured prize.
Cancel the active prediction without awarding Shinies.
Unlock a chat text effect for a viewer.
